tools.name: mcp__tui__screen
tools.description: Read the terminal pane's current contents as plain text, one line per row, exactly as the application drew them, without colours or styles. Call this first; it is the only view of the application there is.

schema.name: mcp__tui__screen
schema.description: Read the terminal pane's current contents as plain text, one line per row, exactly as the application drew them, without colours or styles. Call this first; it is the only view of the application there is.

tools.name: mcp__tui__send_keys
tools.description: Send keystrokes to the application in the pane, then wait up to 0.5 seconds for the screen to change and stop changing, and return it. `keys` is a space-separated list of tmux key names, pressed one at a time in order: Enter, Escape, Tab, BTab, Space, BSpace, Up, Down, Left, Right, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, F1-F12, C-x for ctrl+x, M-x for alt+x; any other word is sent as its characters, so "Escape d" is Escape then d. With `literal` true, `keys` is sent verbatim as characters, spaces included, which is how to type text; send Enter separately. Up to 4096 characters. The keys reach whatever has focus, exactly as typed on a keyboard.
